name: Comix
description: Comix (comix.to) manga provider for Seanime. Needs the cf_clearance cookie and the matching User-Agent from a browser that opened comix.to. With Chrome or Chromium installed on the Seanime host, it refreshes the site's signing keys on its own.
author: Pal & Ari-03

fields.name: cfClearance
fields.label: cf_clearance cookie. Open comix.to in your browser, then DevTools > Application > Cookies > https://comix.to and copy the cf_clearance value.

fields.name: userAgent
fields.label: User-Agent of that same browser. Run navigator.userAgent in its DevTools console and paste the result. It must match the browser the cookie came from.
